summary.zh-CN: 改善 Markdown 长文浏览、会话侧栏信息与运行中插话，并提供不使用稳定设备标识的匿名活跃汇总。
summary.en-US: Improves Markdown navigation, session context, and mid-run steering with anonymous activity summaries that use no stable device identifier.

body.zh-CN: 从预览路径栏查看标题层级，并直接跳到长文档中的对应章节。
body.en-US: Inspect the heading hierarchy from the preview path bar and jump directly to a section in a long document.

body.zh-CN: 悬停会话或项目即可集中查看所属项目、子会话和定时任务等信息。
body.en-US: Hover over a session or project to inspect its project, child sessions, scheduled tasks, and related context.

body.zh-CN: 直接插话与排队插话共享状态和消息呈现，完成后仍保留更多操作入口。
body.en-US: Direct and queued steering share the same state and presentation while preserving message actions after completion.

body.zh-CN: 操作按钮仅在悬停时预留空间，平时展示更长的标题。
body.en-US: Action buttons reserve space only on hover, leaving more room for session titles.

title.zh-CN: 更全面的 beta 更新检查

body.zh-CN: 桌面端 beta 渠道同时检查预览版和正式版，并提示较新的版本。
body.en-US: The Desktop beta channel checks both preview and stable releases and offers the newer version.

title.zh-CN: 自动清除过期队列错误

body.zh-CN: 排队消息已经开始运行时，新的插话会刷新队列并移除过期错误。
body.en-US: When a queued message has already started, a new steering action refreshes the queue and removes obsolete errors.

body.zh-CN: 默认生成按日、周、月隔离的一次性收据，不上传或保存稳定安装标识、账号、令牌、网络信息、消息内容或工具参数。
body.en-US: Separate one-time daily, weekly, and monthly receipts are enabled by default without uploading or storing stable installation IDs, accounts, tokens, network metadata, message content, or tool parameters.
